title: A characterization of two-depth Journé packing for bi-parameter and Zygmund rectangles
summary: We completely characterize a two-depth version of Journé's covering lemma in the bi-parameter setting. Let $\mathcal U$ be an incomparable family of bi-parameter dyadic rectangles contained in $Ω$, and write $e_i(I):=e_i(I;Ω)$ for the two embeddedness depths. For every coordinatewise nonincreasing $w\colon\mathbb N^2\to[0,\infty)$, the estimate \[ \sum_{I\in\mathcal U}w(e_1(I),e_2(I))|I|\lesssim_w|Ω| \] holds uniformly in $(\mathcal U,Ω)$ if and only if the following fixed-total condition holds: \[ \|w\|_{\mathrm{ft}}:=\sup_{N\geq0}\sum_{a=0}^Nw(a,N-a)<\infty. \] For instance,…
